title: Bruce Springsteen, whose wife was treated in Boston, salutes Pan-Mass Challenge participants
author: Peter Chianca
bullets: Bruce Springsteen praised Pan-Mass Challenge organizers in a video, calling them the 'boss of cancer fundraising' at a Worcester event.
Springsteen's wife, Patti Scialfa, treated for multiple myeloma in Boston, influences his support for the Pan-Mass Challenge.
The Pan-Mass Challenge is the largest athletic fundraiser globally, raising over $1 billion for cancer research at Dana-Farber.

title: 1 dead, 4 injured in overnight Hyde Park shooting
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A Hyde Park shooting left one person dead and four injured early Monday, according to Boston police.
The incident occurred at 12:38 a.m. near 1184 Hyde Park Ave, with all victims hospitalized.
Boston Police Homicide Unit is investigating the shooting; tips can be submitted anonymously via phone or online.

title: Review & setlist: Zac Brown Band brings ‘Love & Fear’ – and a whole lot of joy – to Fenway
author: Chris Stevens
bullets: Zac Brown Band performed their record-breaking 15th sold-out show at Fenway Park on August 2, 2026.
The show featured special guests, including Mac MacAnally and Gary Cherone, along with surprise video appearances.
Zac Brown announced a free cruise for all attendees, estimated to be valued at $40 million.

title: Vermont Green FC repeats feat with second straight undefeated championship season
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Vermont Green FC completed a second straight undefeated season, securing the USL League Two title.
Vermont Green FC defeated Flint City Bucks in the final with a decisive penalty by Ryan Zellefrow.
Head coach Chris Taylor remains unbeaten with Vermont Green FC, extending his record to 42 games.

title: Review & setlists: Boston favorite Extreme steals Mötley Crüe’s thunder in Mansfield
author: Christopher Hurley
bullets: Extreme captivated the crowd with an energizing 11-song set at the Xfinity Center in Mansfield on August 1, 2026.
Tesla followed Extreme's strong performance with a set of greatest hits, playing nine songs during their hour-long set.
Mötley Crüe concluded the night with a 90-minute, 16-song performance, complete with classic rock hits and pyrotechnics.

title: BPD searching for missing Roxbury man, 84, with dementia
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Boston Police seek public help to find James Clarke, 84, of Roxbury, missing since Saturday afternoon.
Clarke, who has dementia, was last seen near Hawthorne Street in a black hat and blue flannel shirt.
Clarke frequents Nubian Square and Ruggles Station; tips can be submitted anonymously at 1-800-494-8477.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial enters second week after jurors hear from more first responders
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's trial proceeds with testimonies from first responders and medical professionals about her spinal injuries and her children's treatment.
State Police Sgt. Rose Stoffers testified on photographing Clancy's injuries and documented her use of medication bags acquired by police.
Boston Children's Hospital doctors described brain injuries in Clancy's youngest child due to lack of oxygen, resulting in brain death.

title: Zac Brown gave free cruises to fans at Sunday’s Fenway concert — all of them
author: Chris Stevens
bullets: Zac Brown gifted over 35,000 fans free cruises for two at a sold-out Fenway Park concert.
The giveaway, valued over $40 million, was announced before the band's performance of 'Same Boat'.
Fans can redeem trips on select Margaritaville at Sea cruises, needing to sign up by midnight after the show.

title: Phish brought near-record crowds to this Fenway dispensary — but not a product shortage
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: New Dia Fenway's sales and traffic matched its busiest weekend during Phish's concerts, with no product shortages reported.
The Phish Phan Art marketplace at New Dia Fenway benefited the Mockingbird Foundation and drew international customers.
New Dia Fenway prepares for high-volume events; its 11,000-square-foot space accommodates large crowds with interactive experiences.

title: Red Sox homer 3 times over 7 pitches en route to statement sweep of Dodgers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox hit three home runs in seven pitches during the third inning against the Dodgers.
Boston Red Sox completed a three-game sweep of the Dodgers with an 8-4 win, holding a 60-51 record.
The Red Sox have won 28 of their last 33 games and maintain the second AL Wild Card spot.
